notes.title: Blooming Business: Casino game price reduction
notes.content:
[h2]We have reduced the base price of the game![/h2]

[b]Since we are back as publishers now for our game, we’ve decided to permanently decrease the price of the base game. [/b]

Dear players, Blooming Business: Casino was released over a year ago now! It’s been quite a journey to release a first game as a small indie dev studio, we’ve learned a ton and we’ve been trying to improve the experience as much as possible thanks to your feedback and our understanding of the Steam community expectations. 

It has been quite a thinking process (to be honest ever since the development of the game!). At Homo Ludens, we think it is fairer to revise Blooming Business: Casino’s selling price and reduce it. It's very challenging to identify the correct price point for a game, taking into account the game content, development costs, Steam and publishers fees, and of course the current consumer purchasing power. 

To sum it up, [b]the game price will move from 24,99€ to 19,99€ [/b](for France). We’ve of course revised all pricing for all countries to reflect this decision.

[h2]Happy Summer Sales![/h2]

We’re happy to have a more affordable game that will be even more affordable during the current sales.  The game is at 50% off during the whole Summer Sales!

[h2]Buy? Wait for Sales? Never touch?[/h2]

[b]What’s the deal with those mixed reviews?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/11c907d08adfbe598e2b6f14833d8bd7a59b9870.png[/img]

Having a mixed review score on Steam had a huge impact on our sales and therefore what we could do to support the game. Seeing mixed reviews can prevent interested players from giving a chance (buying) to our game. We’ve tried from the beginning to respond to your feedback by working on the game and patching the game 7 times since the release. We’ve managed to practically come back to a positive review score, but we’re still lacking a few. 
We would like to take this opportunity to respond to some of the most illustrative feedback we received and give you more insights on what we did to improve the game and why we have this score based on our understanding.

[b]A hardcore sim or a cozy management game?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/2241882d7c1492ebf109683bc7f2cb09706d7617.png[/img]

We’ve received a lot of reviews talking about the difficulty of the game and the fact that it’s too easy/ impossible to lose in the game. Indeed, we didn’t want to make a hardcore economic sim game. We wanted to offer a more relaxing and accessible tycoon. How you choose to be profitable, and specialize your casino to respond to the VIPs and client types expectations is yours to set, and there are a lot of different ways as you progress in the campaign. You can focus on building the most profitable business, a luxurious casino, or try to be an exemplary manager to name but a few examples. 
We also chose to develop the narrative of the game with strong VIP characters, a lot of backstory. We put love and passion behind all the writing of the game, from the VIP personalities to the Client type specificities, to the campaign missions, and even the item description and level names! A lot of you appreciated it! 

We understand that some of you would expect and prefer a more challenging simulation experience, and it has been one of our priorities to work on the game to address some of the feedback we received. 
[list]
[*] We’ve changed some aspects of the game. First, we worked a lot on the campaign’s mission-winning conditions, balancing, to make it more challenging. Throughout the 11 campaign missions’ levels, we’ve eased the mission flow clarity and adapted missions that were too easy or too difficult.
[*] Then, we increased the difficulty of the Sandbox difficult modes to have a more diverse experience when you choose the “Hardcore”. 
[*] We’ve also added more failing conditions, you can now get a loan in Sandbox mode, and failing to repay it leads to a game over.
[*] Ultimately, we want you to remember Blooming Business: Casino is above all a relaxing management game. The demo is here to tell you if it's for you or not.[/list]

[h2]We're working on something new! Stay tuned![/h2]

Follow our social media to stay up to date!

🎲  [url=https://twitter.com/HomoLudensGames] X/ Twitter  [/url]

notes.title: Blooming Business: Casino released one year ago!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Anniversary sales and new item for first year owners[/b][/h2]

Dear players,

Our first game, Blooming Business: Casino, celebrates its first anniversary! For this occasion, the game will be [b]50% off[/b] from the 25th of May to the 1st of June.

We will also grant one exclusive item: the [b]Elephant Fountain[/b] to whoever has purchased the game before the 1st of June at 12:55 French time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/27681e7012dcf453ab8b07595e4878fbdfcce6cb.png[/img]

It’s still a great pleasure to organize seasonal events with free items and patch the game based on your feedback! 

[h2][b]Throwback to one year of live ops support[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] 9 Updates in total (3 major updates and 6 patches) since the release of the game
[*] Steam workshop with 4 dev-made mods, and a total of 450 subscriptions!
[*] New game feature: "Hide Wall" feature
[*] Increased Sandbox mode difficulty
[*] 11 new items (free seasonal items: Halloween, Winter season, Lunar New year)
[*] 3175 bugfixes
[*] and tons of improvement[/list]
While there are still some remaining bugs, there was a lot of original feedback that came from issues from the way missions were designed and the balancing was set. We’ve rewrite missions, changed the ways some worked, improved the conditions from success conditions to happen. It responded to a lot of the complaints you made and greatly improved the progression in the campaign.
We wrote a guide to help you with the top campaign pain points. You can access the guide and gameplay tips here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1388580/guides/

[h2][b]We’re now our own publisher[/b][/h2]

We’ve launched the game with the support of Curve Games who has helped us through the last year of development, through the financing, the development and marketing effort to make this game exist to the world. Curve Games has stopped supporting the game for months now. But we still supported it and with the change of publisher we’re happy to finally be able to bring new updates, fixes, and improvements to the game. We will do our best to continue to improve the game and fix potential new feedback, but with a little less regularity.

[h2][b]What the future holds[/b][/h2]

It’s more difficult for us to support Blooming Business: Casino for obvious financial reasons, but we still are committed to patch the game whenever necessary based on your feedback. We still have a few projects and ideas in mind, so stay tuned for more information in the coming weeks!

We organize [b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/bloomingbusinesscasino]monthly streams on our Twitch account[/url][/b] to share more information about our learnings as an indie dev studio.

Also, if you want to learn more about our future projects, you can follow us on [b][url=https://x.com/HomoLudensGames]X[/url][/b] or on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/GHUWCJe6BT]community Discord[/url][/b] where we will chat about all our projects. 

Thank you again for your continuous support!
The Homo Ludens team

notes.content:
Hello Owners!

Here is our penultimate update before the end of the year! As we are almost complete features-wise, it is time to focus on content. [b]Challenge modes[/b]

Each level will come with two “challenge modes” that will be unlocked once the level is finished.
[list]
[*] “Speed mode”: reach your goal as quickly as possible
[*] “Growth mode”:  keep going as long as possible until you reach the end conditions
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Update #15 “Employees & Pitbosses”
notes.content:
Hello Owners!

It’s been a while since our last update. We’ve been very busy with the Gamescom this summer as well as tuning our brand new demo, still playable until the end of October. The following update is [i]NOT [/i] in the demo, but what we did work on right after that.

[b]Employees management[/b]
We deepen employees’ management by adding more options to it, including employee satisfaction which adds further challenges. It is the stepping stone for the Union feature.
[list]

[*] [u]Employees’ satisfaction:[/u] Employees already had an energy need. We gave them a mood (same as clients) impacted by their needs and the beauty around them. When in a bad mood they’ll work badly, impacting the mood of the clients they interact with. On the contrary, when happy they’ll give a bonus to clients. It is then important to keep them happy (now you [i]need[/i] to be a good boss…). We also updated their behavior while on breaks so they could finally use the coffee machine in the breakroom (we all need to be able to drink coffee).

[*] [u] “Unassigned” employees:[/u]  An issue we had was that employees linked to specific area slots (such as bartenders or dealers) were fired when the item was sold, with no way to hire them again. With the new “unassigned” state, employees can be kept even when not assigned to any slot. Be careful then not to hire too many people!

[*] [u]“Roaming” employees:[/u] “Roaming” employees (custodians & guards) offered very few management options as they were. We changed a few things to make the feature more friendly and add some choices. They can now be hired in their own area (namely the security room and the maintenance room) and be assigned to a specific floor. For now, you can furnish up to 2 floors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/c5afa8d5bcd57c4d1d09f7df64f27cedfa4f4f36.png[/img]

[/list]

[b]Pitbosses & lounge area[/b]
With the come back of the lounge area comes a new employee, the Pitboss. Designed to be your right hand(s), the Pitboss can be engaged in small talk, can execute special orders, and be upgraded. Of course, they are beautiful cats, and they are overseeing the bird employees. 

[list]
[*] [u]Lounge area:[/u]  New area where particularly happy customers can come grab a snack and chill. You may notice visitors happily discussing and roaming around. This is where most of the drama will happen, as well as the Pitboss’s corner.

By engaging in small talk with them, you can increase their trust. You can give orders to the pitboss which will trigger a unique behavior. Finally, Pitbosses can be upgraded via their skill tree.
[/list]

[b]New decoration items[/b]
A load of new decorations items! We have expanded the number of items with new space lamps, space columns, and plenty of new furniture. We know you like to customize your own place!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/d18dd5d91cebbb659d68d1bb812d614b7ce15053.jpg[/img]

[b]New languages[/b]
Added new languages, now available on Steam.  Some stories, research, and missions have not been translated yet as they might evolve.

[*] Added level selected by default on the level selector screen
[*] The client counter now only counts clients inside the casino
[*] Fixed mission descriptions on the first load
[*] Fix issues on wallpaper

It is us again, with a new post on our recent development progress! After the huge last update and the thrills of our past playtest, we took a breath and came back with a smaller one. But smaller doesn’t mean it isn’t exciting, far from it. We actually added a whole new level! And color variations on decoration items!

In past playtests, we experimented and presented different types of levels (“the Med”, Sandbox,…), to gather your feedback on our first iterations on what could be our game modes. This time, we worked on a new type of level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/07d45a560d3372b90adb2171d6ace3b1eda2e862.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Update #12 “Third time's the charm !”
notes.content:
Hello Owners!

You might feel like it is the theme of one out of every two updates (and maybe you’re right), but the areas’ designer tool got a do-over, and we strongly believe (and hope) this will be the last of them. It has come a long way since the Tetris pieces, and we hope that you’ll like it as much as we do. Your feedback in previous playtests was instrumental in improving this key feature.

And for more fresh news, we added a whole new underground floor! This new basement will be yours and your employees’ headquarters, where all the important stuff happens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/b30a22d4f525aa2e02313766a8a05218c4af857b.jpg[/img]

[b]Third (or fourth, who’s counting anyway ?) iteration on areas![/b]

If you’ve been following us since the start, you might remember when we first put areas in-game. They were actually advertised in our very first dev update, under those words: 
“Constraints boost creativity which is why we added two new area types, for bars and restrooms. By giving you a frame in which to fashion your games, it will help guide your building while allowing you to better manage your casino.” 
They went from random “Tetris” like pieces to squares, to a drawer tool, to what you’re seeing today. What a journey for our little areas, kids grow so fast!

[u]Minimalist HUD[/u]
Building HUD has been streamlined into 3 slick buttons.
[list]
[*] Create areas: under this menu, you’ll find all areas.
[*] Store: under it, you’ll find every item you can buy in-game.
[*] Build: this is the place to go for walls & floors.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/2f4b949a963eabae705ef3c128dbeabc0987bebf.jpg[/img]

[b]Improved catalog[/b]
The overall look of the catalog has been reworked. You’ll also find some new sorting and filters options.

[u]Areas ready to go[/u]
When building an area you’ll get easy access to its specific items. You can take all the time you need to build the perfect area, and finalize the creation only when you’re happy with it.

[u]Areas sizing[/u]
Sizing and resizing areas have been quite a hassle in the past. With the new tool, you can quickly expand your areas with the side arrows, or be more diligent and give it the exact shape you want with the “segment” feature.

[u]DOORS[/u]
You’ve been heard! YES, YOU ARE NOW ABLE TO PLACE DOORS AS YOU PLEASE! Game devs often joke about doors, but they truly are challenging. It took us a while, but we finally did it and we are as relieved as you to finally be able to place them as we want without resorting to tricks and bug exploits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/658c1bdcadf84291a99bacc43bda9cdf26d36ed5.jpg[/img]

[b]Basement[/b]

Welcome to your new headquarters! In your basement of course, as any self-respecting billionaire would do. A whole floor for you and your employees to manage your business as you please, out of sight.

[u]Employees areas[/u]
All employees' restricted areas will be moved to your basement, as well as the warehouse. This is where employees take their break and have their locker from now on.

[u]Vault area[/u]
With all this cash going on, you needed to have your own super-secure vault, one cannot trust bankers amiright ?
We added a vault area in the basement, the perfect place for you to store your precious money, and for your Clerks to do their job. Clerks love money, they’re magpies, after all.

[u]Cash & chips[/u]
As you may know, in a casino, clients don’t use actual cash to pay for things, if they did they might actually notice how expensive everything is and probably stop right away. They use chips instead.
How does it work? 
[list]
[*] When entering the casino, clients cash in, changing their bills against shiny chips. Then they use those chips for all their transactions into the casino and change back when leaving (usually for a lot less than they had when entering).
[*] But the casino only has a limited amount of chips, and if running out you won’t be able to welcome any more clients. 
[*] That’s where the Clerks come in! Those little magpies will retrieve chips all around the casino, and after counting them, bring them back to the cash register. 
[*] They also get the cash stocked in the cash register and carefully count it before safely storing it in the vault, where you can grab some for more investment in your casino.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/f6256d224839d9ead803bce6ee5c39c3d7bbb6f2.png[/img]

[b]Clerk[/b]

We just talked about this new employee taking care of the vault, you can here admire the magnificence of the magpie!


[b]Bugfix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed animations issue where Nat Kiddin T posed during transitions
[*] Fixed an issue where Nat Kiddin would not exchange her money for chips when entering
[*] VIPs can no longer enter the casino when it’s closed
[*] Th cleaning frequency of restrooms is now correctly saved after being changed

[*] Fixed saved game whith VIPs in it

[/list]

And that’s all for this update. As always, do not hesitate to share your thoughts and questions as we make progress to the development of Blooming Business: Casino. We want to share with you how we progress and are always keen for feedback!

notes.title: Dev Update#11: VIPs in da place!
notes.content:
Hello Owners! 
Here's everything that's new with the game...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/b3a93b029868bd89097dd462368978afa9be890c.png[/img]


[b]VIPs grand arrival[/b]

We want you to experience personal and unique stories!  This is why we are adding special characters - VIPs - to give you the opportunity to experience emerging events.

You will be able to connect with a variety of VIPs and all your choices will impact their behaviors. They have a unique set of skills (for example, Nat can catch cheaters in your casino) and are way more exigent than all the other client types! Gaining celebrity's favor could bring you fame and fortune, but you might have to grease some palms or give the mob a free pass. Is it even possible to run a casino without getting into organized crime?

Let's remind you who are our current super stars!

[u]VIP come back : Tony (Ant’ny Barr)[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/d9f77412cc68f45c55504d770106601a6a03ac55.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Role : Head of the Barr Family
[*] Special ability: When satisfied, throws chips to other clients in a radius around him!
[*] Background: The head of the new crime family who just "ousted" (read: murdered) the Rheeves family. Oddly enough he's not a high roller. When he's around he plays very tight, but he loves to be served by his favorites. If you don't have a staff that he approves of... expect trouble... big trouble. Broken items, maybe even a dead staff member or two... clean up in slots! 
[/list]

[u]New VIP: Nat (Nat Kiddin)[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/9e88390f7b9d48fccc283df08f8dc491397b557d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Role: Police Officer
[*] Special Ability: The Paw of Justice: when satisfied, she can catch cheaters red-handed anywhere on the floor.
[*] Background: Nat's moto is: “shoot first, talk later.” When it comes to law and order, she sees the world in black and white. Her itchy trigger finger gets results, which is why the Sheriff’s department keeps her on the payroll, but there’s always collateral damage, and the department has to do damage control after Hurricane Nat has come through. 
[/list]

[u]VIP Pretty cutscene[/u]
We've also added several new VIP features! The player is now notified of the arrival of a VIP by notifications in the HUD. Clicking on the notification triggers a short cutscene that shows the arrival of the VIP in their own car.

[u]VIP Pretty UI[/u]
At the end of the cutscene, a UI pop-up is displayed, giving more insight into the VIP background, likes & dislikes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/6bf1a562a2ef4209dee4f202fd7805a7f0716e71.jpg[/img]

[b]Bar[/b]

The bar stock management has been revised to be clearer and give more control to the player. The monthly restock was not understood well, and having all bars unavailable all at once every month was an issue. 

[u]Restock[/u]
The monthly restock was replaced by a unit restock. The player can choose a unit threshold under which the barmen will start the restock. The idea is that you can choose between fewer restock that take longer, or shorter and more frequent restocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/7604eb73d005bad70aae09a158072006308a5975.jpg[/img]

[u]Warehouse[/u]
The overall stock of the casino can now be managed from the warehouse. When restocking bars, barmen come to pick up the stock they need from the warehouse. Same as the bar stock, the warehouse stock is replenished when hitting a threshold. With a lower threshold, you restock more units at once which cost fewer thanks to wholesale pricing, but the player takes the risk of being short at some point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/143dd4761924a83b2104fc2dfe0613fe94c3aa99.gif[/img]

[b]Photobooth[/b]

The photo booth is a new in-game item. It was added to deepen the Rockabilly client type who loves the photo booth. It’s not area-bound, so the player can place it wherever they want. It is also a new electric item, which will be useful in the future as we plan to add some energy management.

[b]New music[/b]

The main loop has been reworked. We also added two new music, each for one VIP that will trigger at their arrival.

[b]Live OPs[/b]

We added several live ops features to improve your general onboarding in the game, easily informing you of everything new. We started to implement server-side features and tuning our processes.

[u]News pop up[/u]
The new news pop-up content is fetched from our server instead of being built-in, which will allow the marketing team to customize it at will. It still needs some UI rework.

[u]Analytics update[/u]
We updated our analytics to match the in-game content and ease the processing of data. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/bd96d547ab71008d9db98515ef54bf17f4366e30.jpg[/img]

[b]Bugfix:[/b]

[list]
[*] Re-enable the bouncer hiring in the entrance panel
[*] Add missing animations on VIP
[*] Fix some behavior issues with VIPs
[*] Fixed tooltips errors in story events
[*] Fixed some issues in the bar situation report panel
[*] Fixed issue where clients would urinate outside of the casino
[*] Fixed some awkwardest in item placement
[*] Fixed some issues with the second floor
[*] Added some missing text
[*] Fixed an issue where selling an item next to a wall would delete the wall as well
[*] Fixed some button size issues in the UI
[*] Fixed some items clipping through walls
[*] Fixed issue with keyboard commands registered while typing in a text field
[*] Fixed issue where clients would bet above their money
[*] Fixed issue where clients would not actually pay for their drinks
[/list]

And that’s all for this update. As always, do not hesitate to share your thoughts and questions as we make progress to the development of Blooming Business: Casino. We want to share with you how we progress and are always keen for feedback!

notes.title: Dev Update #10 “Big fish (or bear) in a small pond”
notes.content:
Hello Owners!

For this new update, we focused on adding more personalities & characters to the game. 

It’s the big comeback of our favorite bear, Ant’ny Barr! But as good (or bad?) news never comes alone, he comes with Nat Kiddin the ferocious police officer. They both might bring you a lot of money, but beware as these two could be trouble, more than you can handle.
If you were starting to be bored by miners destroying your slot with their pickaxes, the mobster threatening everyone around, and the tourist spending most of their time taking pictures rather than playing, you’ll be happy to welcome some new clients! The police officers are good clients but don’t mix well with mobsters. Choose which baseball team you’ll support, and their fans will spend in your casino. Finally, the rockabillies will bring some fun and dancing and start the party!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/93aeef9561a45788738b114a2c7625efa8aeac6b.png[/img]

[b]Welcome your newest clients![/b]

Each client type comes with special tastes and expectations!

[u]The Rockabilly[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/b0594b77fe06407652049addc7cf6cf25b5b7f54.png[/img]
Welcome the slicked fur, leather jacket, and swing dresses, a new style is in town! They’re young and they want to have fun. 
[list]
[*] They love arcade games, with all the noise and the excitement that comes with it. They love using the photo booth to take romantic pictures, fun memories, and sometimes some little pranks.
[*] They are breaking the old traditions, old fashioned is out of fashion. They go for anything sweets, soda cocktails, and milkshakes for the win.
[*] Obviously, they are huge music fans and love dancing. The more jukeboxes, the happier they are. But they have very peculiar tastes and won’t hesitate to change songs for their favorite genre, the Rockabilly.
[/list]

[u]The baseball fans[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/330ea25445579bdd2b0e6f5095f3f92f93f3f0fc.jpg[/img]
Baseball is big in the area. Almost everyone has a favorite team that they support wholeheartedly. Bringing baseball fans in is good for business, but you’ll have to choose a team, there is no neutrality in baseball.
[list]
[*] Even if they don’t play it themselves, baseball fans like to picture themselves as great athletes. They will play anything that implies some agility skills to prove themselves.
[*] Their team is everything to them, and they will expect the same from you. Try to show some support with your decorations colors and theme, it will make them happy.
[*] Used to the stadium, they might not take care of their surroundings as you’d like. Be prepared to hire a few more custodians to deal with their dirtiness.
[/list]

[u]The Police Officers[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/cb70fe7c575e12b1fdc6df0f1b5ba9dcb1cc65d5.png[/img]
Where you find mobsters, you find police officers. Like anyone they just want to have a good time, but they sometimes have trouble leaving the job behind. Difficult for them to do nothing when witnessing misdemeanors around. That might get your other clients on edge.
[list]
[*] Police officers are serious people and prefer cards and dice games.
[*] As they are a little uptight, they don’t like laziness or clumsiness. They’ll however be very happy to see employees performing well and being thorough in their tasks.
[*] Mobsters are their natural enemies. And even in this little place of truce, they won’t resist making some arrest if they see some misfit.
[/list]

[b]VIPs grand comeback[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/b837718bead66b218804ed48aabff817902d8f08.gif[/img]

[u]Ant’ny’s back[/u]
The luckiest among you already met Ant’ny a couple of playtests ago. He is back and here to stay. This big bear is the head of the new crime family who just "ousted" (read: murdered) the Rheeves family. Oddly enough he's not a high roller. When he's around he plays very tight, but he loves to be served by his favorites. If you don't have a staff that he approves of... expect trouble... big trouble. Broken items, maybe even a dead staff member or two... clean up in slots!”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/d83e1570ba157db71ad7a977ce1eebbb3795d8fa.gif[/img]

[u]New in town: Nat Kiddin[/u]
This ferocious cheethat is no other than one of the most feared police officers in town. Her motto: “shoot first, talk later.” When it comes to law and order, she sees the world in black and white. Her itchy trigger finger gets results, which is why the Sheriff’s department keeps her on the payroll, but there’s always collateral damage, and the department has to do damage control after Hurricane Nat has come through. Expect some unhappy customers if she finds people and things not to her liking. 
When Nat shows up, make sure she's got no reason to suspect anything underhanded is going on, or you'll be cleaning up broken glass and having to give free drinks and free chips to upset customers, if she doesn't shut you down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/2f664341a6178400cd1de6593b8673c3af1ddeba.gif[/img]

[b]“Swiper no swiping” [/b]
[list]
[*] Some clients now have the ability to cheat at your attractions, making you lose money
[*] You can catch them yourselves, but it will be more efficient to hire guards to do so
[/list]
[b]Plant wear[/b]
Plants will wither over time, and if you don’t take care of it, it will lower the casino beauty
You can water them yourself, or hire custodians to do so

[b]New level[/b]
A new level has been added, available from the level selector. It comes with new challenges, mostly focusing around the new clients: the baseball fan, the rockabillies and the police officers

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/a4b2be045d5cda2860052f81f915762d67ba4a4e.jpg[/img]

[b]Bugfix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Clients can no longer go in staff-only areas
[*] Fixed some missing text in clients’ log panel
[*] Fixed some bathroom issues where clients didn’t satisfy their need
[*] Fixed an issue where bartenders wouldn't restock if they were assigned after the end of the month
[*] Fixed issues with glass walls rendering
[*] Fixed a lot of issues with the French localization
[/list]

And that’s all for this update. As always, do not hesitate to share your thoughts and questions as we make progress to the development of Blooming Business: Casino. We want to share with you how we progress and are always keen for feedback!

Click [url=http://discord.gg/GHUWCJe6BT]here[/url] to join our Discord!

The Homo Ludens team.

notes.title: Dev Update #9 “Context is everything”
notes.content:
Hello Owners!

We hope that the year started well for all of you! On our side we are fired up as ever to bring you the best game we can, but first what is for us the last update of 2021! This update brings a lot of improvement all around, but the most noticeable one is the addition of context, not only on stories. We also added some context around casinos’ levels and clients’ motivations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/98b43348249280fb6312c5ef0eba3b62ec4bd298.jpg[/img]

[b]Stories improvements
[/b]
Stories used to appear out of nowhere and more often than not disturbing the gameplay. No one wants to deal with petty thieves while building the cutest restroom right? Stories now appear in the 3D world on the affected area/item/agent, giving it more context. You can choose to play them at your will, but beware of what might happen if you choose to not deal with it.
We also improved the overhaul stories display with a beautiful UI and dashing artworks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/fac9d232174bb6eeeca11dd4783ad1de47cc8886.jpg[/img]

[b]Anecdotes
[/b]
In a similar vein, we added and made some improvements to what we call “anecdotes”. It's all the small events that appears on the floor such as clashes and chitchat. We added some crowd events such as cheering when someone hit the jackpot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/d4eb421f23b63c133acb22fc2227c73322db6430.jpg[/img]

[b]Clients log
[/b]
Clients’ behaviors might sometimes be hard to understand, which can be an issue when you are trying so hard to make them happy. We added some logs into their panel (the one with their stat and all when left-clicking on them) that should bring light on why they do what they do. This new information should help you know what you can improve in your casino to make them happy, and more importantly to make them give you more money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/692c47d436df4d29b655b0f5aa8f3a32b369fbcb.jpg[/img]

[b]Level Selector
[/b]
We added a new level selector. Right now we have only two levels, but it already give a good idea of what we’re aiming for. It adds more information on level content, and also some lore about our clients types and overall world. It’s still rough and most of the content is placeholder, but in the end it should be a really nice way to learn more about the levels you’ll be playing !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/331fa99ba11a054077c6bcbb2d536b2a2bd14558.jpg[/img]

[b]Graphical experiment
[/b]
If you launch the level “Tikki Miner Mobster’s pie”, you will see that the environment has changed from play daylight to night. We are still trying some things out, but we thought that the night would enhance the festive casino feeling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/ffb1bd86f2fdf5972a01f2e28a92f5b6aa9f20ff.png[/img]

[b]Bugfix
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with wall decorations
[*] Fixed save issue with stairs
[*] Fixed issues with bar restock and icons
[*] Fixed errors in the financial report’s data and formulas
[*] Made some adjustments to the pinball playtime sequence
[*] Fixed issues with floors where some items from the upper floor appeared on the bottom floor 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/5a5fca743c0fc0585265efcdbe556403dab68336.png[/img]

And that’s all for this update. As always, do not hesitate to share your thoughts and questions as we make progress to the development of Blooming Business: Casino. We want to share with you how we progress and are always keen for feedback!

Click [url=http://discord.gg/GHUWCJe6BT]here[/url] to join our Discord!

notes.title: Dev Update #8 “Make yourself at home”
notes.content:
Hello Owners!

You’ve been pleading for it, and we heard you ! It cost us some sweat and tears, but we finally added a construct mode. Walls! Floors! Stanchions! You can build the interior of your casino however you want! We also added a sandbox level where you are free to play as you please. It’s the perfect place to try out the new construct mode. 
However, it’s still rough, specifically the interface. But we plan of improving it before early access, don’t worry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/d2ba7143c179795c7dc416029fe60db96fc445ad.jpg[/img]

[b]Construct mode
[/b]
The construct mode allows you to build & destroy walls inside of your casino and to customize floors. You cannot customize the outside of your casino with it. But beware that you don’t lock up your employees or clients with these new tools. You are also able to modify “automatic” walls that come with certain areas such as Restroom, Locker room & Breakroom.

[list]
[*]Catalog: We added a second catalog with construct mode items. In it, you’ll find the stairs, the walls builder, the walls covering & the floors.
     - Walls builder: it’s only to build new walls. You can choose between concrete walls and glass walls.
     - Walls covering: this category is for walls customizations. You can choose between some tapestries and other cladding like brick, marble…
     - Floors: you can customize your floors with some nice carpets or fancy tiles.
[*]Tools: Those are currently super WIP, but you have a tool to sell/destroy walls and a cancel tool.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/548174d689764eb30cc40eedcdd6b3fc20ceb687.jpg[/img]

[b]Sandbox mode
[/b]
We added a sandbox level that you can access from the main menu, under the “Play” button. In this mode, you won’t have any tutorials or missions. The level is empty with no areas pre-built (apart from the entrance area), you’ll have to build your restroom, break room, locker room … All items are unlocked, and you start with a nice amount of money. We still advise you to start with the main level if you play for the first time, as you might miss some guidance and challenge in the sandbox. But for the more advanced players, it’s the perfect place to try out new builds and strategies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/ba12181623d24f1371b1d695a2e6198305a55c74.jpg[/img]

[b]Bar improvement
[/b]
In the last update, we added a lot of features on the bar, with drinks & stock management. But it was still missing some features. We added some small improvements that give it a lot more flavor.
[list]
[*] Duty stock: you can choose which bartender will go get the restock crate, and which will stay to operate the bar.
[*] Open bar: You made some mistakes when planning your monthly stock and you left with a lot of extras at the end of the month? Don’t worry! It’s time for an open bar, free drinks for everyone! You won’t make money with it, but tipsy clients might be good for you.
[*] Waiters: Witing line on your bar start to get crowded? It’s time to hire a waiter! They will bring drinks to your clients, making everyone gain some time and drink some more. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/130495a9e289380fec667a72621ccb245947bd4a.jpg[/img]

[b]Bugfix[/b]

Walls decorations now snap to walls
Fixed catalog search
Fixed some issues with employees when they were tired but unable to take a break
Fixed some issues and wrong feedbacks on restroom needs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/ddcb1779924d39fdd710ab0ea9c366360e306cff.jpg[/img]

And that’s all for this update. As always, do not hesitate to share your thoughts and questions as we make progress to the development of Blooming Business: Casino. We want to share with you how we progress and are always keen for the feedback!

notes.title: Dev Update #7 “Pardon my French, but this is a hell of an update !”
notes.content:
Hello Owners!

We’re back with, wait for it, a FREE DEMO! As this free demo goes with the Games Made In France event we are taking part in, we felt that it was the right time to add French localization. We worked hard to improve the depth of our existing systems, giving you an idea of what we’re aiming for in the final game. We hope you’ll have fun with this new update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/0e6375a01115a51f18ba069282f4423c94388f22.jpg[/img]

[b]French localization[/b]

You might think that as French is our native language this was an easy one, but it was a crash test for our localization process, and there were some bumps on the road. Also, translating so many jokes was not easy. But we are very happy with the result (looking at you Aristortolan & Platonlaveur)! However it’s possible that there is still some untranslated text or some spelling mistakes, please be indulgent.

[b]New casino layout & areas[/b]

In our last update, we added a tool to allow you to draw areas as you wish. It was the first step, and we added new areas to give more control over your casinos, but to also add some challenges on how to lay them out.
	[list]
[*] [u]Games areas:[/u] we separated games areas into more specific areas such as Slot areas, Cards areas, arcade areas… It should give you more ideas on how to set up your casino, game by game.
[*][u]Locker area:[/u] this is a new area! In this one, you’ll be able to hire floor staff such as custodians (used to be called janitors) and guards.
[*][u]Breakroom:[/u] employees used to be some kind of robot doing their tasks repeatedly. But it won’t be as easy now as we added more depth to them. They might be tired of working non-stop and will need to use the breakroom to relax a bit before going back to work.
[*][u]Warehouse:[/u] This is where your drinks will be stocked before your bartenders use them to restock their respective bars.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/fd9e1faa9e370d0236a2030158b0e93973057b95.png[/img]

[b]Multi-floored casino ![/b]

In the meantime, we reworked the casino layout to give it more personality and add a little more challenge as it is a bit smaller than before. But don’t worry, multi-floored casinos are here! Your casino can now have multiple floors so you can optimize your business and design your masterpiece building as you like

[b]Tutorial & progression[/b]

Based on previous feedback from playtests we tried to give more indications about features that are not straightforward.

We also added some progression with objectives. It’s all tied to your client’s satisfaction, the happier they are the more progress you’ll make. Pay attention to what they like and dislike and everything should go smoothly! As the game progresses you’ll have a variety of clients, and satisfying them all might be quite the challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/27e61fe1c224363b910a611a70a7a4a810d3af40.gif[/img]

[b]Bar management[/b]

We noted that despite Blooming Business being a casino game, most players were really into bars! The bar management was really barebone, so we reworked it to offer more options & challenges. You’ll have to manage what drinks you offer, and how much you stock. But beware, as restock only happens every month, you may find yourself with nothing to serve, or losing remaining stock if you did not anticipate properly. 

And with that, we finally added a very important trait that clients were missing: sobriety! Keep an eye on your alcoholic beverage consumption, tipsy clients might be good for business, but they quickly become inebriated, and nothing good comes from that.

We also added new bars! Each one has a different theme and serve an exclusive drink in addition to the ordinary ones:
[list]
[*] Greek bar serves Negroni
[*] Tiki bar serves Mai Tai
[*] Space bar serves White Russian
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/d881ced1aeda9ba3edb5469c55fd68efac46a632.png[/img]

[b]Employees[/b]

As hinted by the new areas, we reworked our employees’ behavior. They have a [u]limited energy supply[/u] and will make more and more mistakes as they start to get tired. Fortunately, they’ll be able to take some rest in the new breakroom area, but their station will be left empty during this time. You can change when they get to take a break in the areas’ panels, but there’s no easy answer as less break means worse work, and vice versa.

We also added [u]more choices when hiring Employees[/u]. They have different levels of experience, and you can choose between different candidates depending on their stats and needs. But don’t think that you can hire and fire them without blinking, as new candidates will only appear every month. So when finding a good one, you should try to keep them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/7f74c3c476c3fe2ae4cee7aacfeb253a9dc7e2ff.png[/img]

[b]Client types[/b]

Three types of customers will now visit your casino, Tourists, Mobsters and Miners, each of them with its very distinct look. Make them happy and you will attract more clients of the same type, grow your reputation and your income.

[b]Collapses & balance[/b]

As a reminder, if a client’s need falls to 0, you will notice them behaving strangely on your casino floor: drinking in fountains, starting fights with other clients etc.
At this point, you might have seen those clients’ collapses come and go from the game. As fun as it was to have a casino full of people drawing on the floor, it was kinda game-breaking. We work hard to put them back in the game, with a lot of improvement to avoid the previous issues. You’ll get notified sometime before collapses happen, so you’ll be able to do something about it, and collapsed clients will then angrily leave your casino instead of staying there forever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/cb4ceda7e197f63b5cafe0b947b5ef126ee54460.png[/img]


[b]Make the most beautiful & fun casino![/b]

[list]
[*] [u]Items catalog:[/u] In our previous playtests we got a lot of complaints about the catalog’s navigation that was, let’s say, “not optimal”. We separated items into categories (Furniture, Sculptures,...) and added some filter options. 
[*] [u]New decorations:[/u] Many decorations were added since the previous demo. They are now grouped in four themes (Tiki, Space, Greek and Business) with multiple new wall decorations including a rocket(!). • These items will be a great help to cater to the needs of your clients.
[*][u] New entertainment options for the clients.[/u] Casino-goers will be able to play Yahtzee or Yam's, a classic dice game, learn about their future with Sssoltar the soothsayer automation, play Pinball or compete on the Dartboard, to add a little spice to their fun sessions.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40317218/7f1678639cd5f1a882e88d6ae613eede7ae5241e.png[/img]

[b]Bugfix:[/b]

[list]
[*] Game save have been re-enabled
[*] UI: we fixed a lot of UI bugs such as panels going hover others or being out of the screen
[*] Optimization: we fixed the drop in framerate due to notifications, and did an overall optimization of the game
[*] Attractions tweaks: there were some issues on attractions options such as RTP or Casino Cut that have been fixed
[*] Fixed a bug in the 'High Roller Who's a High Tipper' event
[/list]

And that’s all for this update. As always, do not hesitate to share your thoughts and questions as we make progress to the development of Blooming Business: Casino. We want to share with you how we progress and are always keen for the feedback!

[url=https://discord.gg/mHqxpGc6]Click here to join our Discord![/url]

The Homo Ludens team.

notes.title: Dev Update #5 “Freedom is Money”
notes.content:
Hello Owners!

We’re back with a dev update! We had a nice summer and used this time to improve the game usability and add a lot of content! We think this update will make a lot of you happy as it will respond to several of your demands.

[b]New design mode![/b]

Many of you were kinda annoyed by the square areas that felt restrictive and prevented you to make your dream layout. Say goodbye to them! With the new design mode, you’ll finally be able to draw your areas (almost) exactly as you want! Of course, there are still some restrictions such as minimum and maximum area size, but where would be the fun otherwise?

With this mode you can:
[list]
[*] Draw areas in any shape you like
[*] Expand or narrow them later as you wish
[*] Move and rotate areas
[*] Quickly move rotate and delete objects inside an area
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40317218/762d6a42395496e5d17a11f2c99fbb171e2e49ce.gif[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40317218/4e99ef470a8354d35618a65c3affc284d4bfb2c8.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Standard:[/b] Keep it classy with our 50’s standard decoration. Some might find it boring, but some clients might prefer it that way, Casino is not only about fun, it is also about business after all.[/list]
[list]
[*] [b]Tiki:[/b] Invite your clients into an island paradise. The idea of adventure and relaxation combined might invite them to forget their (financial) worries and spend more on your machines.

[list]
[*] [b]Greek: [/b]A classic in casino theme, but always a win. Who doesn’t like marble columns, fancy fabric, and huge fountains? There’s nothing that invites you to spend your money as much as the souvenir of fallen Empires.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cTURRDj.gif[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40317218/a42ea73e12f503d6841fe0f8ef8707ef86bad51d.png[/img]

[*] Fixed issue where clients didn’t give back their glass to the bartender

And that’s all for this update. As always, do not hesitate to share your thoughts and questions as we make progress to the development of Blooming Business: Casino. We want to share with you how we progress and are always keen for feedback!

The Homo Ludens team.

notes.title: In our Tycoon game, you have to build your A team!
notes.content:
Hello Owners!

It’s Paul again, the fellow lucky enough to be the Creative Director for Blooming Business: Casino! I sincerely hope you are well, dear readers. Today I would like to talk about our vision for the building brick of any good casino : game areas and the people running the Casino for you, those you need to count on, your people, your crew, your A team: [u][b]the Pit Bosses[/b][/u].

[h3][b]The areas’ basics![/b]
[/h3]

Now, during the last demo events, many players have told us they would prefer more freedom in setting up their areas. Well, we will be changing how areas work in the future: we want you to build areas just how you want, so you’ll be able to draw your own !

[b]Game Area Specialization[/b]

A small recap on the basics of casinos : the longer you stay, the more money they make. You think you might earn back some of your gambles but given enough time, casinos will always win back what they gave you. Now in Blooming Business : Casino, you will have to adapt your game areas to your clients. While some will prefer smaller bet amounts, others will be attracted to games with expensive bets. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UEOMEUh.png[/img] 

So as a casino owner, you will need to take this into account when building and specializing your areas! For example :
[list]
[*] “[b]Boxman role[/b]”: Setting up a craps table with a second employee to speed things up might not pair well with small bets. Clients will play more games in a given timeframe (making you more money) but maybe that won’t be enough to cover the second employee’s salary, putting you in the red !
[*] “[b]One Armed Bandit Maintenance”[/b] : Slot machines can be set up to be maintained less often, lowering your operating costs, but saving on an additional janitor might come around to bite you when all your machines break down at the same time ![/list]

[b]Decoration : Beauty & Theme[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aKjcgJf.png[/img] 

How your clients perceive your areas is very important. Clients will tend to enjoy any type of beauty, they will pay special attention to themes.
Every single object in the game has a number of tags that clients can sense (Exotic, space, ancient greece… ). Some clients really enjoy the ‘exotic’ tag so they will be drawn to areas with many tikki objets and spend more time there! However if they can’t play because that area is already full, they will leave without spending any money and give you a bad review! 

So in the future you will need to pay attention to what clients want and provide just that. Of course, if you want to create a casino just the way you want, you can, you might not make as much money.

[h3][b]Here comes the Pit Boss![/b]
[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z7RPzPm.gif[/img]
[i]and it's a CAT[/i]🐱🐱🐱

First of all, in our game there are two types of employees : the normal ones, numerous, reliable but not really able to evolve that much. And when your Casino becomes *big*, you will have dozens of normal employees, and as the Owner, you just won’t have time to take care of everyone. That’s where the second type of employee comes in : the Pit bosses will be real characters, with a lot of personality, a real capacity for evolution and tricks that will make them essential to any successful Casino Owner.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tLriPmB.gif[/img]
[i]See their cute skin variations?[/i]😍

[b]Pit Boss' progression / bonuses![/b]

In time, your Pit Bosses will acquire experience, allowing you to specialize them exactly how you want to so that they will give exactly the right bonuses to your Casino floor and play right into your hand. In the demos we teased them. We had three pitboss bonuses : 
[list]
[*] [b]Reliable Slot Machines[/b] : Slots in the area wear down a lot more slowly, and so don’t need to be repaired as much. 
[*] [b]Sleight of Hand [/b]: Blackjack tables in the area give back less chips to clients when they win, making more money for you.
[*] [b]Loaded Dice[/b] : Clients playing craps in the area have 10% more chance to lose big.
[/list]

[b]Narrative events & drama![/b]

Don’t lose sight of one thing though: betrayal always comes from those you trust. As I mentioned just above, Pit Bosses are real characters and they will be the actors of many of the narrative events that we have in Blooming Business: Casino. Maybe they are particularly strong and will not think twice about dropping a poor sod in the desert for you, but they might just as well hate a particular regular and ask you not to let them come back, or even ask for a raise! Of course, you’re the boss, boss. But you will have to live with your choices and their consequences.

That’s it for today, I hope you’ve enjoyed this little tidbit, I cannot begin to tell you how excited I am for this particular feature because I believe that you will grow to love your Pit Bosses and I can’t wait to hear all the stories you will live with them at your side !

[list]
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.gg/GHUWCJe6BT][b][u]Discord[/u][/b][/url]
[*] Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/BloomingBiz][b][u]Twitter[/u][/b][/url]
[*] We launched our [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@bloomingbusinessgames?lang=fr][b][u]Tik Tok[/u][/b]. [/url] account! Share the word 🎉
[/list]

Hasta pronto, Owners!

notes.title: Dev update #3 & Feedback from the Demo - “Polishing”
notes.content:
Hello Owners!

We’re back with a dev update! This will be a special one. After the rush of the demo for the Steam Next fest, we took some time to analyse your feedback and work on features prioritization for the Early Access release. These past weeks, we focused on finishing systems and cleaning our code base. 

[h2][b]Demo key learnings[/b]
[/h2]
Before deep diving into this Dev update, let’s talk about our feedback regarding our first pre-early access demo! First, we want to say a big thank you to everyone who tried the demo and took the time to provide feedback! We’re really grateful for all the inputs, ideas and positive reception we got.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qVEhcJd.jpg[/img]

We’ve of course received plenty of detailed feedback on what to improve, develop, or even add. Some of these suggestions were already in our minds, and we've included the new learnings in our milestones’ plan. We will soon get back to you to let you know how we progress on this: 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TVEU56s.jpg[/img]

To participate in the game development, test the latest improvements and additions during upcoming playtests, you can join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/GHUWCJe6BT]Community Discord[/url][/b]! 
We also started to post dedicated information regarding our amazing characters! Tune in each Thursday on our social media accounts to learn more about them: [url=https://twitter.com/BloomingBiz][b]Twitter[/b][/url] / [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CREA2jYIn9W/][b]Instagram[/b][/url]!

[h2][b]Dev Update #3[/b]
[/h2]Our main focuses were:

[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
We fixed a lot of issues in the UI such as things displayed on top of another, and tried to improve it by adding some features, and reworking the way we filter the catalog.

[h3][b]Restroom[/b][/h3]
As you may have noticed the restrooms and janitor were kinda buggy, whether it was the Janitors not cleaning or the clients who didn’t go when they needed it. We implemented new cleanliness rules, and fixed the janitor's behavior.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IVhTYQf.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VxxPile.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Bar[/b][/h3]
The bar was missing some features, such as the stock management of the drinks and refills.

[h3][b]Overall improvements[/b]
[/h3]You might not notice it, but we’ve worked on a lot of technical improvements : We reworked the way agents detect things around them and do some cleanup on their behavior. We also reworked the way we manage localization so that we could have more languages in our next release!

[h3][b]Bug fix:
[/b][/h3][list]
[*] You can now fire all employees [i](but that would be ruthless… right!?)[/i].
[*] Fixed bouncer behavior that prevented clients from entering [i](and we want to make profit…)[/i].
[*] Fixed blocker when an event happened while grabbing someone.
[*] Fixed some missing localization.
[*] Fixed a bug on Strike events that kept appearing [i](Oups)[/i].
[*] Fixed display issue with the beauty overlay.
[*] Fixed data in the casino panel.
[/list]

And that’s all for this update. As always, do not hesitate to share your thoughts and questions as we make progress to the development of Blooming Business: Casino. We want to share with you how we progress and are always keen for feedback!

Kriss from the Homo Ludens team.

notes.title: Dev update #2 - “Areas management”!
notes.content:
Dev update 2 - June 4, 2021 -  Areas’ management

Hello Owners!

We are back with Dev update #2 to showcase how the development of Blooming Business: Casino is going and highlight some of our key features. This time, we have added more depth to management in the game and in particular the “Game area” and “Entrance area”. Casino owners will have more control over the flow of clients visiting your casino and have additional options to improve the efficiency of games and utilities areas (restrooms, bars…).

We also prioritised various adjustments (tutorial flow, UI improvement,...) based on the feedback of our community members who participated in the latest playtest! We want to thank them again for their crucial and valuable inputs.

If you want to know more about what to expect for the Early Access release and what the team focused on these past weeks, read all about it below.

[b]Important announcement[/b]! We will reveal more about our gameplay during the next [url=https://www.guerrillacollective.com/blog/games/blooming-business-casino/][b]Guerrilla Collective event on June 12th[/b][/url]. You can check out their website and activate the notification on Twitch. Also, stay informed by joining our Discord community server or following us on Twitter ! 

[h2][u][b]New features[/b][/u]
[/h2]

[h3][b]Our different areas[/b]
[/h3]As a quick introduction, Blooming Business: Casino offers a system of areas to guide you and help you manage and optimize the different aspects of your business. There are 3 types of areas, all with dedicated information panels to better understand & optimise your performance and operational options. Let’s go in a bit more depth :

[h3][b]1) Game area[/b]
[/h3]
[/olist]This is where you can place your casino games (slot machines, blackjack tables, etc...) and where your dealers operate. During this development milestone, we continued working on Game areas with new options and details within the operating menus. There are new operational functionalities (sell, move the areas,...), an improved shopping experience and additional menu information.


[h3][b]2) Entrance area[/b]
[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZokXy72.gif[/img]
We implemented a new area type, the “Entrance area”! It enables you to open or close your casino, regulate visitors flow and attract different clients. You will be able to open or close your casino if needed, add a bonus entrance sign, monitor specific KPIs such as number of entries, waiting time, standing level...
Overall, it will give you more control over who you let in, and it comes with a new job for guards : the bouncer! Clients will no longer go through stanchions, since the bouncer will now let them in !

[h3][b]3) Convenience Areas[/b]
[/h3]“Restrooms” and “Bars” will attend to your clients' most vital needs ;)... Moreover, we’ve improved the restroom area : You will now be able to choose how and when to clean it. However, whenever a Janitor has to clean the room, they will close it entirely, so make sure you have another somewhere in your Casino ! If a room isn’t cleaned enough, Clients won’t be able to relieve their needs as much and will spend less time playing. And you don’t want that !

[h3][b]Our first VIP is here[/b]
[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1AALNAt.gif[/img]

Our very first VIP is here! [b]Meet Ant’ny Barr[/b] (or just ‘Tony’); our famous mafiosi bear. Ant’ny is one of the *charming* personalities you will be able to meet in the future. He is the head of the new crime family who just "ousted" (read: murdered) the Rheeves family. Oddly enough he's not a high roller. When he's around he plays very tight, but he loves to be served by his favorites. If you don't have a staff that he approves of... expect trouble... big trouble. Take care of him or he might show his bad side.

Playing the game, it will be vital to connect with VIPs and learn their backstories, needs, goals and desires. Specialize your casino and adapt your management in order to cater to their craziests pet peeves for big rewards !

[h3][b]Sit on couch[/b]
[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mFF76vG.gif[/img]

We heard your playtesters, our dear clients can finally take sit on couches to take a break from all the crazy emotions from your floor !

[h2][u][b]Major improvements[/b][/u]
[/h2] 

[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
A lot of issues and improvement areas were reported about our UI. Although it is not definitive yet, we made some changes to make it more user friendly and easy to understand.
We added outlines on objects, changed some names and improved its overall look.

[h3][b]Tutorial[/b]
[/h3]We always update our tutorial to show off our new features. But this time we also added some story to go with it, and we really try to give a better feeling of progression through it.

[h2][u][b]Minor adjustments:[/b][/u]
[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Options[/b]: we added some graphic options for better game experience
[*] [b]Loading screen[/b]: we added a loading screen so the game doesn’t seem to freeze when starting.
[*] [b]New animations[/b]: we created more animations for existing characters to give a more lively feeling
[*] [b]New sound balance[/b]: we changed the sound balance to put more emphasis on casino sounds. However this is still super rough.
[*] [b]Character movement[/b]: We improved character movement so they don’t go through walls anymore and their motions seem more natural.
[/list]

[h2][u][b]Bug fix[/b][/u]
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Selling tool cursor now displayed the right icon
[*] Mouse outside screen edge now work even in fullscreen
[*] Game area panels open as expected
[*] Issue movement with camera at start is fixed
[*] Beauty layer don’t break agent’s texture anymore
[*] Event’s choices tooltip is fixed
[*] Restroom walls don’t clip with existing walls anymore
[*] Areas can be placed even when totem are already here
[/list]

And that’s all for this update. As always, do not hesitate to share your thoughts and questions as we make progress to the development of Blooming Business: Casino. We want to share with you how we progress and are always keen for feedback!

We're looking forward to sharing more about the game and what new features we will be adding very soon! In the meantime, we are discussing with our community on [url=https://discord.gg/GHUWCJe6BT][b]Discord[/b][/url]. Join us and be informed about upcoming playtests! 

Kriss from the Homo Ludens team.

notes.title: Dev update #1 - “Beauty & the beasts”!
notes.content:
Hello Owners!

How are you? It’s been a little while since our announcement but it’s for a good cause : We’ve been very busy implementing a lot of new features to go from an “aquarium” to an actual game! Today, we are very excited to share our first Dev Update and more details about what we've been working on these past weeks.

During this milestone, we included marvellous new additions! We’re calling this update “[b]Beauty & the beasts[/b]” for reasons you’ll soon find out, we focused on how we can really give you control over your casino and add more life! Read on to learn more about the update, what you can expect for the Early Access release, and how it will affect the gameplay.

🎉[b]Please note we are organising our first closed playtest with a selection of players this weekend[/b]! 🎉 

If you are interested in trying the game, this is your chance to enjoy all these great additions. If you want to know more, check out the details by joining [url=https://discord.gg/GHUWCJe6BT][b]our Discord community server[/b][/url]. Thanks again to all of our very first supporters, friends & family members, we take all of your feedback into account! 💚

[h2][b][u]New features[/u][/b]
[/h2]

[h3][b]New areas[/b]
[/h3]
Constraints boost creativity which is why we added two new area types, for bars and restrooms. By giving you a frame in which to fashion your games, it will help guide your building while allowing you to better manage your casino.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oxecjhX.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Lx9iwfa.png[/img]

[h3][b]Who is the fairest one of all?[/b]
[/h3]
Casinos spark the imagination, they are all about glitter, glamour and greatness. With our new beauty system, clients will appreciate all the effort you put in making your casino such a nice and attractive place. But beware, they won’t be happy if they find litter laying around.

[h3][b]Events[/b]
[/h3]
Something happened! We added our first narrative events to spice up the game a little. You’ll have to make crucial (maybe) decisions to resolve all these contingencies and experience the pressure of a real casino’s owner!

[h3][b]New browsing experience[/b]
[/h3]
We entirely reworked our catalog to make it easier to find that perfect addition that will make the place come together perfectly!  There, you will find customization items, casino games and many other things... You should have fun with our sorting tools and explore a whole new shopping experience! Don’t forget to check out our plants, everyone likes a bit of greenery.

[h3][b]Clients interactions[/b]
[/h3]
Who else is bored with social distancing? Find a breath of fresh air in your casino where people can talk to each other, share drinks or even fight! Now, it is possible to admire visitors living their best life in your (future) casino!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pqXPlWF.png[/img]

[h2][b][u]Minor adjustments:[/u][/b]
[/h2][list]
[*] New client: the magnificent, the marvellous, the soft, the wild: [b]the Chamois[/b]! 💚 (We will soon show you this cute addition on our social accounts, you can follow us on our social accounts if you want: [url=https://www.instagram.com/bloomingbusinessgames/][b]Instagram [/b][/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/BloomingBiz][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!).
[*] First full UI rework.
[*] New sounds.
[*] Better camera and controls.
[*] Sound options in the pause menu.
[*] Rebalancing of the game.
[*] We now have 4 steam achievements.[/list]
[h2][b][u]Bug fix:[/u][/b]
[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now place areas on already placed totems.
[*] Fixed client grabbing.
[*] Fixed some animations.
[*] Fixed pathfinding while the game is on fast forward.
[*] Fixed bar queue.
[*] Fixed some bugs on save.
[*] Fixed loo placement.
[*] Clients can’t wander around the casino anymore.
[*] Fixed clients blocked at cashier.
[*] Fixed some onboarding steps.
[/list]
And that’s all! We plan to update you at the end of each of our internal dev milestones. The goal is to give you more visibility regarding the directions and the development of 🍀Blooming Business: Casino🍀. Thank you Owners, do not hesitate to share your thoughts and questions as we make progress. We take your feedback very seriously!

We're looking forward to sharing more about the game and what new features we will be adding very soon! In the meantime, discuss with the dev team in our [url=https://discord.gg/GHUWCJe6BT][b]Discord[/b][/url]!

Kriss from the Homo Ludens team.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SAKk8ga.png[/img]
